support_claim: Commercial notes explicitly establish that billing invoice naming and Companies House registry naming for Helion Robotics Limited denote the same legal entity, and billing and registry sources ground both referents to that shared name and company number 11847201.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use the billed name "Helion Robotics Limited".
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the invoice-side name observed in the packet.

propositions.proposition: A second billing observation also records the billed name "Helion Robotics Limited".
propositions.relevance: Corroborates the billing-side name associated with the left referent.

propositions.proposition: Registry row 11847201 lists the registered company name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED in England and Wales with status active.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent registry:11847201 to the registered legal name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that invoices and Companies House both use "Helion Robotics Limited" and that this denotes the same legal entity as the CRM operating name "Helion Robotics Ltd".
propositions.relevance: Explicitly links the invoice/billing naming convention to the Companies House/registry naming convention as the same legal entity, bearing on whether billing:Helion Robotics Limited and registry:11847201 denote one counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from the Helion Robotics entities discussed.
propositions.relevance: Establishes that a similarly named Helion entity is distinct, but does not directly establish distinctness between billing:Helion Robotics Limited and registry:11847201.
